kind: Late confirmation and preview route regression, plus explicit compatibility consent withdrawal

counterfactual.purpose: Expected pre-fix failures, executed before editing the three production files; tests are byte-identical in the passing run.
observedFailures: Home or newly opened page disappeared after repeated pop.
Pending save failed to keep the editor mounted.
Cancellation followed by stale preview callbacks closed the underlying operation page.

finalTarget.command: flutter test --no-pub --concurrency=1 --reporter expanded test/unsaved_confirmation_race_test.dart test/preview_route_race_test.dart test/save_inflight_race_test.dart

assertions: Each confirmation accepts at most one response and only while its own route is current.
Back-dismissing a confirmation invalidates old keep/discard callbacks; later fresh confirmation still works.
After awaiting permission to leave, recheck the original route and live saving state.
A stale preview cancel cannot close the underlying page; a stale confirm after cancellation creates no write or protection copy.
Withdrawing compatibility consent before a new frame blocks an old enabled confirm; database and backup bytes remain unchanged.
Renewed consent restores complete 1000-character title and 2001-character note with one replacement and one protection copy.
limitations: Widget and in-memory repository contracts only; no physical Android or SQLite persistence claim from these cases.
Final integrated analysis, full tests, build and native CI are recorded separately.
Earlier 56-test and 20-test source evidence remains bound to the previous frozen source, not silently rebound.
